[quote=abadi-jr;59735583][i]What is an Hydronia?![/i]
Ka'ak-Duur questioned to the other Ërshuun, one of them, Eren, answered, as he takes the paper to read again.
 [i]This is human writing, so therefore must be something human, this man, Kaplan Zorlu seems to be inviting us for something.[/i]
[i]I see...I am afraid, there is no response we can send in matter of 2 days, would anyone here be willing to go to such "Hydronia"?[/i]
The Zheks(Zhekvekk) present nodded in non-agreement. Ka'ak-Duur sighed, and said.
[i]Y'all so afraid to leave our nation, despite being our habitat, contact with other sapients is also important, prepare the galiot, I will not be willing to swim today.[/i]
[i]Understood sir.[/i]
They all answered in understood, Eren got aboard the galiot alongside the Thrrum-ennak, he wasn't an Ërshuun, yet the heir and apprentice of Ka'ak Duur, despite the cold, which could be deadly to humans, for the Zhekvekk, they were already well adapted. 
[i]I see land, and a blue and orange flag, let's get into this place.[/i]
It was the coast of Yorgul, they didn't know, but would need walk a bit much to reach where they should, quickly Ka'ak-Duur got into the icy waters, his body well adapted to swim, they rapidly managed to get into the coast, with his fangs clashing against the rocks, he got into land, and helped his apprentice, it was night, he looked around, it was all different from his homeland, despite being cold the Zhekvekk wear no cloths as their skin is thick and can project enzymes to protect their bodies from freezing at such temperatures, however they also bought a packet of Esh'gurt to keep hydrated and Khay(tea...?) to present, and a letter in response...?
[i]Now, where is a city named Hydropolis located...? Master?[/i]
The master gave a short glance at his apprentice and said.
[i]I don't know neither.[/i][/quote]

Earlier that day, a small fishing boat off the coast of Vafir had spotted odd movement in the waves. At first they thought it was a shark, but after closer inspection they saw humanoid shapes. They had immediately reported it to the police, but thanks to the bureaucracies of the federal system, it took a while for this info to reach the state police and coastguard of Yorgul, when the Zhekvekks had already left the coastline well behind them and were deep into the heart of Hydronia. The federal police in Hydropolis were eventually notified of the strange creatures and this information was then passed onto the government. When the president was finally notified of the Zhekvekks presence in Hydronia, we knew that Narrvekk must have accepted their request. Police across the country have been given orders to find the Zhekvekks and bring them to Hydropolis, so that the meeting may commence.
